- [research/recovered/knowledge_history1/reports/knowledge/REF_AUDIO_VORBIS.md:116](../../research/recovered/knowledge_history1/reports/knowledge/REF_AUDIO_VORBIS.md?plain=1#L116-L116) — - ID `REA-LOCAL-20261031-15H-P0-VORBIS-POSTINIT-RETURN-LOSS-STATIC-01`; source `rea_lab/decomp_task/REA_20261031_15H_P0_VORBIS_POSTINIT_RETURN_STATIC.md`. At `0x5D4D20`, three successive `outer+0x68`, `outer+4`, `[outer+4]+0x1C` pointer gates produce -1 on a missing dependency, otherwise initialize fields and return 0. The successful-core path of wrapper `0x5D5BD0` executes `0x5D5BFB -> 0x5D4D20` but overwrites EAX with zero, and callers `0x5CF970/0x5CFA10` locally check wrapper status before state 4.
